hero.title: Biotechnology in Finland for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Biotechnology in Finland is an excellent study option for Indian students interested in life sciences, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, food technology, environmental science and industrial innovation. Finland offers internationally recognised Biotechnology courses with strong research and practical components, including English-taught master's programmes at universities such as Aalto University and the University of Helsinki. Students can develop expertise in areas such as molecular biology, microbiology, bioinformatics, bioprocessing, drug development and biomanufacturing, preparing them for careers in biotechnology companies, pharmaceutical industries, research organisations and academia.
